results.title: Tokyo dispatch: Piyush Goyal would like to see 1,580 Suzukis in India
results.description: India's trade minister seeks more Japanese investment in India, citing Suzuki's success. He met with Sumitomo, Meiji Seika Pharma, and Mitsubishi to boost collaboration in various sectors.

results.title: Delhi cop rescues 16-year-old girl from suicide attempt at Hauz Khas Metro station
results.description: In a heroic act at Hauz Khas Metro Station, Constable Nikita intervened just in time to save a sixteen-year-old girl who was on the verge of jumping onto the tracks. With the help of station staff, Nikita escorted the distressed teenager to the control room. There, police contacted her father, and after sharing her details, the girl, who struggles with a mental health issue, was reunited with him safely.
